name: Mooney M20
summary: Fast, efficient four-seat retractable single produced in many versions since 1955, known for its distinctive 'backwards' tail.

wings: Low, tapered wing with a straight trailing edge, set low on the fuselage
engines: Single flat-four or flat-six in a long, low cowl
fuselage: Low-slung, compact four-seat cabin with a single right-side door
tail: Vertical tail with a vertical rudder hinge line so the fin appears swept forward

tellTales: Vertical tail that looks swept forward
Short cabin with a long nose

confusedWith.howToTell: The Comanche's fin is swept back; the Mooney's tail appears to lean forward.
The PA-28 has fixed gear and a conventionally swept fin; the Mooney has retractable gear and a forward-looking tail.
The V35 has a V-tail; the Mooney has a conventional fin and horizontal tail.
